name: Sports Store: Idle Business Tycoon 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Sports Store: Idle Business Tycoon is a fun idle game that puts you in charge of a sports nutrition store with a big mission—help your customers transform their bodies and lifestyles. Start with a small stand, sell muscle-boosting goods, and watch your customers grow stronger in real time as they use your products.
